text:
The most common Hakone booking mistake we see: paying extra for "a room with open-air bath" without checking what's in the tub. Here's a 4-step checklist to save before you book 👇

📌 Save this for your Hakone booking (the full comparison is here) 👉 https://japanbystation.com/hakone-private-onsen-which-booking

✅ SAVE-THIS CHECKLIST

1️⃣ Search the room description for the words hot spring, onsen or gensen. One Gora ryokan's room page says plainly that its in-room baths are not onsen water, with reheating instead.

2️⃣ Ask how the inn's private bath is booked. At Kiritani Hakoneso it's ¥3,600 for 50 minutes for two, limited to five groups a day, requested when you book and allocated in check-in order.

3️⃣ Check in as early as you can. Kiritani's check-in opens at 15:30; arrive near the 18:00 cut-off and you take whatever slot is left.

4️⃣ Want a guaranteed time? Hakone Yuryo near Hakone-Yumoto Station takes online bookings for its private open-air rooms from one month ahead until 15:00 the day before. Weekday last entry is 18:00.

💡 One more detail people miss: some ryokan take cash only at the front desk. Kiritani's plan page says so, so bring enough yen.

We'd rather you spend your evening in the water than at the front desk working out what you paid for.
